# `foxglove sites ingest-path-policy`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](sites.md)

```text
Get or save a site's ingest path policy

Usage: foxglove sites ingest-path-policy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  get   Print a site's latest ingest path policy revision as JSON
  set   Save a site's ingest path policy from a JSON file
  help  Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
